[1/6] Plan the seven cockpit and frontier improvements: vector reticle and point transit animation, calmer events, combined reactor+abilities panel, auto-height imperial outliner, 8 more star systems, 2 more planets per system, and 6 more surface operations.

impact_assessment.why: The user reported seven gameplay/UI gaps: vector selection has no visible marker or transit animation, blocking events interrupt too often, reactor and abilities are split across two strip panels, the imperial outliner runs past its sections, the galaxy has too few systems and planets, and landing offers only five operations.
impact_assessment.benefits: A selected vector is visible and animates like body transit; quick-time prompts become rare; one coherent command panel replaces two cramped ones; the left drawer ends with its content; about 31 systems and 7-8 planets each deepen exploration; extra surface operations give landings distinct risk/reward choices.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the G-013 three-equal-column strip and its layout tests are superseded; dependency: none, changes stay stdlib/vanilla JS; concurrency: decision cadence and event throttling must remain deterministic and save-compatible; state: new stats defaults must load old saves, and point/body animation state must not leak between trips.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Record G-016 and an ADR, replace the superseded layout assertions with the combined-panel contract, keep old-save fallbacks, pin point animation, cadence and surface availability with regressions, then run the full suite, aikit gates and real-browser screenshots.

checkpoints.description: [2/6] Vector reticle, point-transit animation, combined reactor+abilities panel and content-height imperial outliner implemented; focused layout and browser checks pass.
[3/6] Decision cadence is relaxed by default with one roll per 36-tick window and an initial grace; war headlines are capped at one per tick with a 12-tick cooldown.
[4/6] Nine star systems and two extra planets per system added (32 systems, seven or eight bodies each); war overextension core raised to six so expanded starting realms are not penalised.
[5/6] Surface catalog expanded to thirteen operations with environment gates, and the headless captain now reaches landings and quantum-link hails.
[6/6] Documentation and ADR-087 recorded; 780 tests pass and 5/5 project gates pass. checklists: passed
